verdict.rationale: In-person user groups and meetups are a fair ecosystem question for a popular UI framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions SolidJS meetups, local user groups, or any way to find or join them. Generic statements about a growing ecosystem of libraries and utilities do not address in-person community events.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find and join a local in-person user group or meetup for the framework
